body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Sharp presented ''RD-CMP2000R'' an electronic dictionary equipped with 180-degree swiveling screen during KES 2006. Besides English-Korean dictionary content, it also contains digital camera, FM radio/recorder, touch screen, and memory card slot.

< AVING Special Report Team for ''KES 2006'': Publisher & Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Gaius Park, Phoebe Kwon, Sheri Choi, Joshua Shim, Daniel Sirh, Rose Kim, Paul Kim, Samuel Kim, Abe Shim, Grace Won >
